SELECT , p.product_name AS productName, t.team_name AS teamName FROM scrum_sprints s LEFT JOIN scrum_products p ON s.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN scrum_teams t ON s.team_id = t.id
s.is_deleted = 0
AND s.product_id = #{queryForm.productId}
